comparison.objective: Candidate installs and screws a rack rail; record hangs a holder on two headed keyhole studs.
comparison.physical_skill: Both align a rigid object at two separated attachment sites and release it to self-support. Candidate adds handed long-rail support, tab depression, paired spring-prong insertion at front and rear, telescoping, and screw driving; record inserts two heads through wide openings then lowers them into narrow slots.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four prongs, returned springs, matched rack units, bottom-hole screws, and 3 s support; record requires both shanks bearing on closed slot ends, upright pose, clearance, rest, and 1 s release.
comparison.reason: This is a real attachment-skill neighbor, but keyhole insertion-and-drop tests a different retention path from staged spring latches across rack depth plus fastening. Candidate prong, level, load, and screw tolerances remain unquantified.
